consolidate_checkpoints: consolidate all FSDP distributed checkpoints in a directory into a single consolidated.pth file
load_from_checkpoint: load a model and optional optimizer state dict from a distributed checkpoint directory using dcp.load
CheckpointManager_save: save model state dict, optimizer state dict, train state, and config to a timestamped checkpoint folder
CheckpointManager_load: load model, optimizer, and train state from the last saved checkpoint or a specified path
CheckpointManager_instantiate_and_make_d: instantiate a CheckpointManager and create the checkpoint directory on the master rank with a dist barrier
